description: Cartridge-local index for MLB-M1 performance, follow-up, and run artifacts. Heavy daily artifacts stay in data-private, published-data, and development-docs.

preSlateRead: May 30 quiet-start and traffic-without-conversion lessons are active for May 31 full-game side gating.
Full-game sides should stay secondary when the same matchup has a cleaner first-five, first-inning, total, or prop expression.
Generic total-bases props remain demoted unless the player row has a named damage-contact or starter-fit support tag.
May 31 should be graded separately for side picks, F5/timing lanes, HRs, tracked props, and MLB-RP36 bridge reads.

lessons: Full-game sides overreached when the pick had quiet-start or traffic-without-conversion risk.
First-five and first-inning timing lanes were more useful than broad full-game confidence on this slate.
Total-bases props should stay out of core slots unless they have a narrow hitter/starter reason.
Any underdog side needs a named path: opponent dead-early, opponent traffic-no-conversion, opponent chaos gap, snapback pressure, or same-series suppression.

openModelChanges.summary: Treat quiet-start, traffic-without-conversion, and quiet-first-five rates as MLB-M1 full-game side veto/penalty inputs for May 31+ slates.
Keep generic total-bases overs out of core/top-pick slots unless the row has backed damage-contact support and enough sample.
Publish pitcher strikeout under probabilities as side-specific probabilities instead of the raw over-side probability.
